assumptions.limitations: Equal state allocation is arithmetic only. Enriched feed share is allocation of units to a different, unverified feedstock, not a national MSW composition estimate. Current feed supply and domestic processing capacity are unknown. Output tonnes, climate proxies and ROI require all original v0.3-v0.5 assumptions. This model has no commodity price equilibrium, labor/equipment manufacturing constraints, inflation, borrowing costs, delays, methane disturbance or national refinery-build cost. No economy-of-scale or 3D-printing savings assumed. Hawaii should use its separate island overlay.
